record.title: Nakamura’s conjecture on the three-dimensional G-Hilbert scheme
record.statement: For every finite subgroup $G\subset SL(3,\mathbb{C})$, the $G$-Hilbert scheme $\operatorname{Hilb}_G(\mathbb{C}^3)$ is a crepant resolution of the quotient $\mathbb{C}^3/G$. Here $\operatorname{Hilb}_G(\mathbb{C}^3)$ parametrizes the zero-dimensional $G$-invariant subschemes of $\mathbb{C}^3$ whose space of global sections is isomorphic, as a $G$-module, to the regular representation of $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2004/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/708), page 7. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lebesgue-constant growth for polynomial interpolation on the sphere
record.statement:

\|\Lambda_n\|=O(n)$ as $n\to\infty$?

record.title: PTAS for the \epsilon-Dense Steiner Tree Problem
record.statement: An \epsilon-Dense Steiner Tree instance consists of a graph $G=(V,E)$ with unit edge weights and a terminal set $S\subseteq V$ such that, for every terminal $s\in S$, $|N_{V\setminus S}(s)|\ge \u0005epsilon\,|V\setminus S|$, where $N_U(v)=\{u\in U:\{u,v\}\in E\}$. For every fixed $\u0005epsilon>0$, there is a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the $\u0005epsilon$-Dense Steiner Tree Problem.

record.title: Harris–Morrison Slope Conjecture
record.statement:
Let $s_g:=\inf_{D\in\operatorname{Eff}(M_g)}s(D)$, where $s(D)$ is the slope of an effective divisor on the moduli space of stable curves of genus $g$. The Harris–Morrison Slope Conjecture asserts that
\[
s_g\ge 6+\frac{12}{g+1}.
\]

record.title: Classification of local Todd-class coefficient functions
record.statement:
Classify all functions $\mu$ that give a local formula for the Todd class, meaning that for every fan $\Sigma$ they satisfy
\[
\operatorname{Td}(X_\Sigma)=\sum_{\sigma\in\Sigma}\mu(\sigma)[V(\sigma)].
\]
Here $X_\Sigma$ is the toric variety associated with $\Sigma$, and $[V(\sigma)]$ is the class of the orbit closure corresponding to $\sigma$.

record.title: Complex interpolation of compact operators under compactness at both endpoints
record.statement:
Let $(A_0,A_1)$ and $(B_0,B_1)$ be compatible Banach couples. Suppose that $T:A_0+A_1\to B_0+B_1$ is linear, that $T:A_0\to B_0$ is compact, and that $T:A_1\to B_1$ is also compact. Does it follow that, for every $\theta\in(0,1)$, the induced operator
\[
T:[A_0,A_1]_\theta\to[B_0,B_1]_\theta
\]
is compact?

record.title: Critical static structure-function asymptotic at the critical temperature
record.statement:
The report records the conjecture that, at inverse critical temperature \(\beta=\beta_c\), the static structure function satisfies
\[
\widehat u_0(k)\mathop{\sim}_{k\to 0} \lVert k\rVert^{-2+\eta},
\]
with critical exponent \(\eta=0.03\) for \(d=3\) and \(\eta=0\) for \(d\ge 4\).

record.statement: For the Kob–Andersen kinetically constrained lattice gas on the three-dimensional cubic lattice with constraint parameter $m=3$, numerical simulations conjectured an ergodic/non-ergodic transition at a critical density $\rho_c\approx 0.881$: the infinite-volume process would be ergodic for $\rho\leq\rho_c$ and non-ergodic for $\rho>\rho_c$.

record.title: An improved conditional bound for the summatory Möbius function
record.statement: Assuming the Riemann Hypothesis, with $M(x)=\sum_{n\le x}\mu(n)$, Helmut Maier and Hugh L. Montgomery report that the estimate $M(x)\ll x^{1/2+\varepsilon(x)}$ is valid with $\varepsilon(x)=1/(\log x)^{22/61}$, improving the earlier admissible choice $\varepsilon(x)=1/\log\log x$.

record.title: Existence of a 3-dimensional totally skew disc in 7-dimensional space
record.statement: Does there exist a 3-dimensional totally skew disc in $7$-dimensional space, i.e. in $\cmathbb{R}^7$? Here, a totally skew submanifold $M^n\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ is one for which, for every pair of distinct points $x,y\in M$, the tangent spaces $T_xM$ and $T_yM$ contain neither intersecting nor parallel lines.

record.title: Gaussian maximizers for the Strichartz inequality in dimensions one and two
record.statement: For the free homogeneous Schrödinger Strichartz inequality in dimension $d=1$ or $d=2$, with exponent $p=2+4/d$, an initial datum $f\in L^2(\mathbb R^d)$ is a maximizer—i.e. equality holds in the sharp estimate $\|e^{it\Delta}f\|_{L^p(\mathbb R\times\mathbb R^d)}\le S_d\|f\|_{L^2(\mathbb R^d)}$—if and only if $f$ is a Gaussian. The sharp constants reported are $S_1=12^{-1/12}$ and $S_2=2^{-1/2}$.

record.statement: For a graph $G$ and a non-negative integer $g$, the following are equivalent: (1) There exists a drawing of $G$ on an orientable surface of genus $g$ such that $\\operatorname{cr}(M)$ is even for every perfect matching $M$ of $G$; (2) $G$ is $4^g$-Pfaffian; (3) $G$ is $(4^{g+1}-1)$-Pfaffian.

record.title: Clean POVMs
record.statement: Which POVMs are “undisturbed,” namely they are not irreversibly connected to another POVM via a channel? For POVMs $P$ and $Q$, define $P\succ Q$ iff there exists a channel $E$ such that $Q=E(P)$. Define $P\simeq Q$ iff both $Q\succ P$ and $P\succ Q$ hold. A POVM $P$ is called clean when, for every POVM $Q$ such that $Q\succ P$, one has $Q\simeq P$. The problem is to characterize the clean POVMs.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/04](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/785), page 12. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finitistic dimension conjecture
record.statement:
For an artin algebra $A$, define
\[
\operatorname{fin.dim}(A)=\sup\{\operatorname{pd}_A(M)\mid M\text{ is a finitely generated left }A\text{-module and }\operatorname{pd}_A(M)<\infty\}.
\]
The finitistic dimension conjecture asserts that $\operatorname{fin.dim}(A)<\infty$ for every artin algebra $A$.

record.title: Inversion of adjunction for minimal log discrepancies on normal \Q-Gorenstein varieties
record.statement:
Conjecture: Let $X$ be a normal $\Q$-Gorenstein variety, let $Y$ be a proper closed subscheme of $X$, and let $\lambda>0$. If $D\subset X$ is a normal effective Cartier divisor with $D\not\subseteq Y$, then for every proper closed subset $B\subset D$,
$$
\operatorname{mld}(B;X,D+\lambda\cdot Y)=\operatorname{mld}(B;D,\lambda\cdot Y|_D).
$$

record.statement: Suppose that \(G\) is simple, \(R\) is abelian and acts faithfully on \(G\), \(p>3\), and \(F^*(C_G(\alpha))\) is a \(p\)-group for every \(\alpha\in R^\#\). Then \(R\) is cyclic.

record.title: Alexander–Orbach conjecture for the incipient infinite cluster
record.statement:
For the incipient infinite cluster $\widetilde{\mathcal C}$ in $\mathbb{Z}^d$, for every $d\ge 2$, the transition density satisfies $q_t(x,x)\asymp t^{-2/3}$ as $t\to\infty$. Equivalently, if
\[
d_s(\widetilde{\mathcal C})=-2\lim_{t\to\infty}\frac{\log q_t(x,x)}{\log t}
\]
when the limit exists, then the Alexander–Orbach conjecture asserts that $d_s(\widetilde{\mathcal C})=4/3$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/828), page 41. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Alexander–Orbach walk-dimension conjecture for the incipient infinite cluster
record.statement:

\[
d_w(\widetilde{\mathcal C})=3.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/828), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Planar Brownian intersection exponent formula
record.statement:
For the planar Brownian intersection exponents defined in the report, Lawler, Schramm, and Werner proved that

$$\xi_2(M,N)=\frac{\left(\sqrt{24M+1}+\sqrt{24N+1}-2\right)^2-4}{48},$$

for the integer package sizes $M,N$ occurring in the preceding definition. In particular, $\xi_2(2,2)=35/12$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/828), page 56. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniqueness for the truncated PML Maxwell problem
record.statement:
For $R_t$ sufficiently large, the only $\boldsymbol{\theta}\\boldsymbol{\theta}\\boldsymbol{\theta}\\Theta\in H_0(\operatorname{curl};\Omega_\infty)$ satisfying
\[
-\bigl(\mu^{-1}\nabla\times\Theta,\nabla\times\Psi\bigr)_{\Omega_c}+k^2\bigl(\mu\Theta,\Psi\bigr)=0
\quad\text{for all }\Psi\in H_0(\operatorname{curl};\Omega_\infty)
\]
